summary: The milestone supports a review of newly matured evidence, not a claim of learned market skill. Prospective tests have both supportive and negative lifecycle classifications, but supplied evidence does not establish incremental value over baselines or independent replication. uncertainties: Candidate-level scores, effect sizes, baseline comparisons, regime results and independent replication evidence are not supplied. A MATURED_SUPPORTED label alone does not establish skill; some supported candidates have very small matured counts.
